name: claude-skills
description: Portable skills for Claude Code and Codex. Claude Code uses this repository as a plugin marketplace; Codex uses the same skills through its local skill directory.

plugins.name: toolup
plugins.description: Stops an agent reporting a missing tool and handing you a shopping list. Finds what is actually installed (including off PATH), installs free software itself, converts documents headlessly via Office, LibreOffice or a browser, and never installs anything needing an account without first telling you what signup involves.

plugins.name: no-legal-waiver-wallpaper
plugins.description: Strips the caveat sections, hedges and self-undermining closers from anything an agent writes for other people to read. Doubt goes to the user in chat; the document carries what was asked for and nothing else.
